description: Recent audit records at a specified stage
sql:
SELECT decision_id, stage, timestamp, symbol
      FROM auto_trader_audit
      WHERE stage = :stage
        AND timestamp >= :since_ms
      ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT :n
limitations: Do not combine local and runtime results
Do not assume paper/live mode from table names
execution_plan: SEARCH auto_trader_audit USING INDEX auto_trader_audit_stage_timestamp (stage=? AND timestamp>?)
